description: Source code for the Data Collection and Analysis (DCA) component, including functions for processing log files, handling telemetry data, and interfacing with CCSP message bus. Contains API implementations, log processing, and JSON output generation.

methods.name: processTopPattern
methods.description: Processes log file patterns to retrieve load average and process usage.

methods.name: appendData
methods.description: Appends data to telemetry node, handling memory allocation.

methods.name: processTr181Objects
methods.description: Processes CCSP message bus objects for telemetry data collection.

methods.name: addToJson
methods.description: Adds processed data to JSON output.

methods.name: getIPVideo
methods.description: Extracts specific pattern data from log lines.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Extracts RDK error codes from log lines.

methods.name: handleRDKErrCodes
methods.description: Handles RDK error codes found in logs, updating error code list.

methods.name: processCountPattern
methods.description: Processes log files for pattern counts and error codes.

methods.name: processPattern
methods.description: Main pattern processing function, calls specific handlers based on log type.

methods.name: strSplit
methods.description: Splits string based on delimiter, similar to strtok.

methods.name: getDType
methods.description: Determines data type (string or int) based on pattern and filename.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses configuration MAP file to set up pattern processing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, initializes and runs pattern processing based on command line args.
